title: 史上最好的猎手卡牌扩展(Ultimate Silent Card Expansion)
description:
[h1] Overview [/h1]
This mod adds 37 brand-new cards for The Silent, including 1 Ancient card, 16 Uncommon cards, and 20 Rare cards, bringing players a much richer variety of strategic choices.

[h1] TODO [/h1]
- Optimize localization
- Balance adjustments
- Art optimization & polish
- Refine existing content: discard uninspired or poorly designed mechanics, and add more cards that genuinely enhance the gameplay experience.

[h1] AI Generation Disclosure [/h1]
AI tools were used during the development of this project to assist with coding, debugging, and art asset creation. All AI-generated content has been manually reviewed and adjusted.
[i]This is a pure passion project made on a tight budget. Thank you for your patience and understanding![/i]

[h1] Localization [/h1]
As non-native English speakers, we are highly open to any suggestions regarding our English localization! If you spot any unnatural phrasing or translation errors, please let us know.

We would also love to bring this mod to more players around the world! If you are interested in helping us with community translations into other languages, please feel free to reach out.

[h1] Feedback [/h1]
Feel free to leave a comment if you have any feedback or suggestions! 
You can also join our QQ community group: 939342993
Rate 👍 if you like it! Your support keeps us going!
changeNote:
v0.4.4
修复：USCE 不再拦截非静默猎手角色的先古之牙初始卡选择，修复与崩坏进阶同时使用时战士、故障机器人等角色一进二未转换初始卡的问题。
修复：将探索者加入共用的初始卡先古升级列表，使 RitsuLib 的尘封之书选择器正确排除它，修复与崩坏进阶组合使用时二进三可能重复获得探索者而非幽魂的问题。
新增：内置语言诊断日志，记录版本、语言切换调用来源、翻译缺失/覆盖及卡牌显示语言异常；设置记录上限，避免持续刷日志。出现语言异常时，请反馈游戏 logs 目录下的 godot.log。
说明：语言自动反复切换、语言表重载丢失文本及合成牌中文/重复前缀仍未解决。本次先古奖励修复影响后续新计算的奖励选择，不回收旧存档已发放的卡牌，也不迁移其他模组已缓存的待发奖励。
